title: Copy All Diagnostics
summary: Puts every lint finding for the current unit onto the clipboard, starting from the Structure form
intro: Read this when you want to paste a unit full list of findings into a chat, issue or note. Right-click in the Structure form and choose Copy All Diagnostics to put every lint finding for the current unit on the clipboard.

surfaces.caption: Copy All Diagnostics
steps: Open the Structure form (drag-lint > Show Structure)
Choose Copy All Diagnostics; every finding of the current unit is on the clipboard

help: drag-lint lint  <path>       [--profile <name>] [--target-compiler <ver|auto>] [--rule <id>] [--disable id1,id2] [--rules-dir <dir>] [--json] [--labels] [--no-preprocess] [--library-db <lib.sqlite>] [--build-config <name>]
[--db <index.sqlite>]  (a store enables the type-aware and ancestry checks, and the project
rules for this file, incl. the ON opt-in discarded-effect-free-result; the OFF opt-in ones run only under --rule)
<path> may be a FOLDER: every scanned .pas/.inc/.dpr gets the same checks as lint <file> (their union)
[--output <file>]: with --json or --format sarif the document is written to the file instead of stdout (a note on stderr).
[--project-rules]  (also run doc-drift/missing-doc for this file -- OFF by default:
they rebuild facts PER DECL, ~16ms each, and can exceed the IDE's 8s budget)
[--stand-in-for <realpath>]  (analyse <path>'s TEXT as though it were <realpath>:
for editor buffers snapshotted to a temp file -- fixes store membership, file id,
unit-name and the reported path)
drag-lint lint  --project <file.dproj> [--build-config <name>] [--rule unit-not-in-dpr] [--json]
drag-lint lint  --in <f.pas> --fix [--fix-line <L> --fix-rule <id>] [--fix-naming] [--apply]   (AUTOFIX one file)
DRY RUN WITHOUT --apply: it reports what it would change and writes no source file.
--fix-line + --fix-rule together narrow the fix to ONE finding; omit both to
apply every fixable finding in the file. Only rules whose catalog entry has
"fixable": true are ever applied -- see `drag-lint rules --json`.
--fix-naming: consent, in a batch run, to the opt-in naming fixes (renames across
every owning project) without listing them in "autofix" in drag-lint-lint.json;
it also prints "rename-local: <N>" (stderr) for the single-project renames.
This is what the IDE Structure form's right-click Fix it / Fix all in unit run.

questions.ask: How do I paste every lint finding of this unit into a chat or issue?
